practice.message: VIN_5V rings to 10.16 V on a step to 4.985 V, 104% over. The source's inductance and the capacitance on the net form a resonant circuit with little to damp it. Damp it with an electrolytic capacitor in parallel or a small resistance in series with the ceramic one, and check the peak against the absolute maximum of everything on the net
practice.source: Analog Devices AN88, Ceramic Input Capacitors Can Cause Overvoltage Transients

practice.message: The source on VIN_5V supplies a peak of 19.15 A while the capacitors charge, against 0.3013 A once settled. Charging current is C * dV/dt, so a slower edge or soft-start lowers it. Check the peak against what the supply, connector and any fuse allow
practice.source: TI SLYT332, Taming linear-regulator inrush currents
